requirements.title: UNPACK argument restrictions
requirements.definition: VECTOR shall be a rank-one array with size at least the number of true MASK elements, MASK shall be a logical array, and FIELD shall have the same type and type parameters as VECTOR and be conformable with MASK.

pending.UNPACK-VECTOR-rank-one: Positive source control uses integer VECTOR=[101,202,303]; source-control mutation supplies rank-two VECTOR and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.UNPACK-VECTOR-size-covers-true-MASK-coun: Use MASK with three true elements and VECTOR size three; companion all-false MASK uses zero-sized VECTOR to cover t=0. Source-control mutation shortens VECTOR to size two.
pending.UNPACK-MASK-logical-array: Use rank-two logical MASK with mixed true and false values; source-control mutation supplies integer MASK and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.UNPACK-FIELD-same-type-parameters-as-VEC: Use integer VECTOR and integer scalar FIELD=-9 plus integer array FIELD; character companion uses VECTOR character(len=3) and FIELD character(len=3). Source-control mutation changes type or character length.
pending.UNPACK-FIELD-conformable-with-MASK: Use FIELD array shape [2,3] with MASK shape [2,3] and scalar FIELD companion; source-control mutation uses FIELD shape [3,2].

pending.UNPACK-all-false-mask-yields-FIELD: Use all-false MASK shape [2,2], zero-sized VECTOR, and FIELD array [11,12,13,14]; assert the whole result equals FIELD, paired with mixed MASK companion.

accounting.rationale: Description defines UNPACK as unpacking a vector into an array.
Result Value separates true-MASK VECTOR placement from false-MASK FIELD fill.
True MASK elements take VECTOR elements in array element order.
Remaining elements take scalar or corresponding FIELD values.
